calibration.coordinate_definition: Schematic, anisotropic relative coordinates. Center red line x=0, right blue line x=1, transverse center y=0, far board floor contact y=-1. Near side y=1 uses symmetry about center. Ends estimated from observed floor/board contact after camera registration. No meters or feet.
limits: Manual approximate floor lines, not surveyed landmarks.
Near side floor is partially hidden by boards; symmetric half-width assumption.
Image registration includes static background and assumes approximately fixed pan camera; parallax and distortion remain.
Physical aspect ratio and rink dimensions are not measured. Do not infer distances, speed or total floor time.
Only currently observed player feet may be projected; off-camera players remain missing.

Unitless draft replay with manually approximated floor lines. Person-masked static-background registration, two-bank agreement <=20px at visible floor grid, camera interpolation <=1/3s. Neither agreement nor residual proves ground accuracy. Current detections only. Original frame sampling can differ by one source frame from cached tracks. SAM2 replaced BOT-SORT after the exposed goalie/skater failure audit. Full-frame pose retained because crop models emitted hidden feet. Pose is reused only for one-to-one matching boxes with IoU >=0.5. No manual identity correction; all IDs remain fragments. Uniform contradictions split tracks; matching uniforms do not establish identity. This development guard can also break correct tracks.
foot_definition: Midpoint of both predicted ankles, both confidence >=0.5 and track not truncated at bottom. Not a verified foot contact. No box-bottom fallback.
tracking_method: automatic SAM2.1-large, detector-seeded, player filter before association and uniform contradiction guard
